All-Inclusive Camping & Adventure Package

The complete Kodaikanal adventure: Offroad Jeep Safari and Waterfall Trekking are fully included with our Sunset & Sunrise Ridge Camping as one seamless package!

All-In-One Package Camping + Jeep Safari + Waterfall Trek

Wilderness Camping with 4x4 Jeep Safari & Waterfall Hike

Step into the authentic mountain lifestyle of Kodaikanal. We combine high-altitude ridge camping with an exhilarating open 4x4 offroad jeep safari through pine woods and a guided shola waterfall trek into a single, hassle-free adventure.

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

Our signature camping package includes overnight alpine ridge camping (with weather-tight tents, warm sleeping bags, and 360° sunset & sunrise views), an exciting 4x4 offroad jeep safari through mountain trails, and a guided waterfall trek through ancient shola woods. Campfire and freshly cooked meals are also arranged upon request!
We provide clean, well-maintained cabs driven by experienced local hill drivers in 3 categories: Comfort Sedans (up to 4 guests), Spacious SUVs / MUVs (up to 7 guests), and Group Travelers (for 8+ guests), ensuring comfortable travel across all hill terrain.
Yes! Campfire setups, live barbecue grills, and freshly prepared South Indian or North Indian home-style meals are gladly arranged upon prior request when planning your stay.
